user_requirements: VERIFICATION ROUND (round 2) of a legal draft — not an acquisition analysis. SPA_DRAFT_V2.md is the revised Agreement for Sale and Purchase of Shares (Nikki Wairau Christian to Ahmad Duais, $260,000: $100k at settlement 1 Aug 2026, $80k 1 Sep, $80k 1 Oct). ROUND1_FINDINGS.md is the previous review of the v1 draft — 25 findings (F1-F25) each with exact suggested wording, ALL of which were meant to be applied in v2 (except F1, a factual gate that keeps its placeholders, and F13's drafting-notes removal which was done). deal_facts.txt holds the agreed deal terms; PRECEDENT_ProHost_2023.pdf is the base template. Your job: (1) VERIFY APPLICATION — for each of F2-F25, check the v2 text implements the round-1 suggested wording faithfully (quote any divergence and say whether it matters); (2) CROSS-REFERENCE AUDIT after the renumbering — every internal clause reference in v2 must resolve correctly (the round-1 report's renumbering note lists the danger points: cl 2.3→15, cl 3.1(e)→9, cl 12.1(a)→14.4, cl 15.3→17, cl 16.5's clause list, cl 10.5's references, cl 11.2-11.3, cl 14.4's clause list, cl 17.1(c)); (3) NEW-DEFECT SWEEP — hunt for any defect the amendments themselves introduced (contradictions between new clauses, a definition now used before/without definition, survival-clause list omissions, double obligations); (4) DEAL-TERM RE-CHECK — all numbers, dates, parties, company numbers unchanged and still exactly matching deal_facts.txt; (5) confirm the regulatory-integrity constraint still holds everywhere (nothing restrains regulator communications; cl 14.4 reaches cl 4.3/4.4 as intended). Output: a verification table for F1-F25 (APPLIED CORRECTLY / APPLIED WITH DIVERGENCE / NOT APPLIED), then any NEW findings with severity and exact fix wording, then a final sign-readiness verdict listing exactly what remains before the draft can go to the solicitors. Be strict: this is the last automated gate.
acquirer_context: Same context as round 1: purchaser-side pre-lawyer hardening, deferred consideration, vendor knows the template, open PSPLA/CIPU regulatory process means nothing may conceal or fetter regulator communications. The verdict of this round decides whether the draft goes to Franklin Law.
